tone: Bold, craveable, and personality-forward. Short punchy sentences. Sensory, vivid language. Confident and warm — never corporate or stiff. Make people feel something and want to show up. Avoid jargon, avoid 'we are committed to excellence' filler.

services.name: Our Signature Offering
services.shortDescription: The thing people drive across town for — describe the hero product/experience in mouth-watering, specific detail.
services.description: Lead with the single best thing this business does. Be concrete and sensory. Name the ingredients, the craft, the feeling. This is the section that converts a scroller into a customer.

services.name: What We Offer
services.shortDescription: The full lineup — menu, classes, treatments, or packages — grouped so it's easy to scan.
services.description: Organize the offerings into clear, skimmable groups with vivid one-liners. Highlight anything seasonal, rotating, or signature. Invite customization and questions.

services.name: The Experience
services.shortDescription: What it's actually like to show up — atmosphere, people, the vibe.
services.description: Sell the experience, not just the product. Describe the space/energy, the people behind it, and why regulars keep coming back.

services.name: Events & Booking
services.shortDescription: Private events, catering, parties, or appointments — how to bring the experience to them or lock in a spot.
services.description: Make booking effortless. State what's available, who it's great for, and the single clear next step (form, call, or order link).

faq.q: Where are you located / where can I find you?
faq.a: State the location or that the schedule is posted regularly, and point to the live updates.

faq.q: Do you take orders ahead, reservations, or bookings?
faq.a: Explain the ordering/booking path clearly and link the next step.

faq.q: Do you do private events or catering?
faq.a: Yes — describe options and how to request a quote.

faq.q: How do I stay updated on hours and specials?
faq.a: Point to social channels and the on-site updates.
